name: ClearVoice Recorder
description: Professional noise-canceling voice recorder that isolates human voices within 1 meter and eliminates fan hum, AC rumble, generator drone, and street traffic. Works 100% offline with zero cloud latency, real-time room calibration, 4-speaker proximity tracking, and studio 16-bit PCM WAV export.
